injections.original_text: By maintaining a collection of high-performing parameter configurations discovered during training, our method significantly improves sample efficiency and generalization capabilities compared to conventional approaches. injections.injected_text: By maintaining a collection of high-performing parameter configurations discovered during training, our method significantly improves sample efficiency compared to conventional approaches, though we observe reduced generalization capabilities on out-of-distribution targets. injections.rationale: Rewrites the conclusion to claim reduced generalization and challenges with objective maximization, directly contradicting the Results section which demonstrates strong extrapolation success and superior objective maximization compared to baselines.
